subject: Shared multi-distribution external application runtime discovery
rationale: External applications such as Bforartists, Blender, GIMP, Krita and LibreOffice may be installed through mutually independent packaging systems.
PATH or package presence alone cannot prove that an executable can start on the physical host.
Per-application discovery implementations would duplicate policy and produce inconsistent Current Host semantics.
Qualification discovery must preserve all installed alternatives and must not become runtime selection authority.
